convention: R = horizontal, G = vertical, B = 128. Byte 128 is neutral; 0 is -1, 255 is +1. Positive X moves right; positive Y moves down.

maps.name: Horizontal Flow
maps.description: Uniform rightward drift; a simple direction and travel test.

maps.name: Diagonal Flow
maps.description: Uniform down-right drift; rotate or invert for other directions.

maps.name: Radial Outflow
maps.description: Move outward from the center with distance-scaled strength.

maps.name: Radial Inflow
maps.description: Pull inward toward the center with distance-scaled strength.

maps.name: Clockwise Vortex
maps.description: Clockwise circular flow, calm at the center and stronger toward the edges.

maps.name: Counterclockwise Vortex
maps.description: Counterclockwise circular flow with a still center.

maps.name: Inward Spiral
maps.description: Clockwise rotation combined with an inward pull.

maps.name: Outward Spiral
maps.description: Clockwise rotation combined with an outward push.

maps.name: Horizontal Shear
maps.description: Opposing horizontal travel above and below the center.

maps.name: Vertical Shear
maps.description: Opposing vertical travel left and right of the center.

maps.name: Saddle Flow
maps.description: Expand horizontally while contracting vertically.

maps.name: Wave Flow
maps.description: Alternating horizontal waves with a smaller vertical ripple.

maps.name: Radial Ripples
maps.description: Concentric rings alternating inward and outward motion.

maps.name: Checker Drift
maps.description: Hard checkerboard cells move in alternating diagonal directions.

maps.name: Tiled Vortices
maps.description: An array of smooth alternating eddies, with still points between cells.

maps.name: Soft Turbulence
maps.description: Smooth independent value-noise vectors; broad cloud-like drifting.

maps.name: Curl Flow
maps.description: Rotated gradients of a smooth noise potential; curved circulation.

maps.name: Layered Eddies
maps.description: Overlapping seeded vortex structures with varied scale and spin.

maps.name: Cellular Drift
maps.description: Nearest seeded cells each carry a fixed travel direction and distance.

maps.name: Broken Blocks
maps.description: Coarse broken bands and blocks with independent seeded vectors.

maps.name: Pinwheel Sectors
maps.description: Twelve alternating angular sectors turn into a sharp geometric pinwheel.

maps.name: Diamond Orbits
maps.description: Circulate around nested diamond-shaped contours with sharp corners.

maps.name: Square Circulation
maps.description: Follow square contours around the center, switching at diagonal corners.

maps.name: Hexagonal Channels
maps.description: Six discrete directions turn a swirling field into hexagonal channels.

maps.name: Alternating Spiral Rings
maps.description: Concentric bands alternate between inward and outward spiral motion.

maps.name: Twin Vortex
maps.description: Two opposed rotating structures meet along a central seam.

maps.name: Quadrupole
maps.description: A four-lobed saddle structure produces opposing streams and curved seams.

maps.name: Vortex Street
maps.description: Alternating rows of offset eddies carry a gentle rightward current.

maps.name: Sine Braid
maps.description: Interwoven diagonal sine currents make smooth braided displacement.

maps.name: Crossed Ripples
maps.description: Two off-center ripple systems intersect in an interference field.

maps.name: Chevron Current
maps.description: Alternating V-shaped bands make angular zigzag streams.

maps.name: Stepped Columns
maps.description: Columns advance through four stepped travel directions.

maps.name: Diagonal Shards
maps.description: Seeded diagonal slices travel independently like broken panes.

maps.name: Barcode Slip
maps.description: Narrow vertical strips have seeded vertical slip and smaller sideways errors.

maps.name: Quantized Turbulence
maps.description: Smooth noise directions snap to eight compass directions and four strengths.

maps.name: Multiscale Curl
maps.description: Broad circulating currents carry smaller curls from a second noise octave.

maps.name: Ridged Current
maps.description: Noise ridges modulate a smooth rotating current into clustered folds.

maps.name: Cellular Attractors
maps.description: Each irregular cell pulls toward its own seeded center.

maps.name: Cellular Orbits
maps.description: Small irregular cells circulate around seeded centers with hard field seams.

maps.name: Shockwave Front
maps.description: An off-center elliptical shock front alternates radial push with circulating motion.
